major_concerns: Verifier semantics are underspecified (which invariants exactly will be checked; formal definitions missing).
Simulator fidelity and mapping from simulator failures to production-impact not defined.
Dataset provenance for the 200 intent prompts not fully specified (possible leakage, representativeness concerns).
Limited detail on exact LLM model/identifier, temperature, and retry policy—these affect results and reproducibility.
Potential for repair step to introduce new semantic faults not captured by verifier; need instrumentation to detect introduced regressions.
required_design_repairs: Specify deterministic verifier formalism and exact semantic checks (syntax, reachability tests, loop detection, policy rules) and thresholds.
Declare exact simulator (version), topology templates, and how simulator-observed failures map to the binary safety label.
Provide provenance and sampling procedure for the 200 intents; ensure train/test separation from any retrieval/repair corpora.
Record exact LLM(s) with model identifiers, prompt templates, hyperparameters, seeds, and frozen retry policy in preregistration.
Add explicit evaluation of 'repair-induced' regressions and a mitigation plan (e.g., verifier re-check after repair and logging of repair diffs).

major_concerns: 'Actionable' misconfiguration threshold is underspecified and may not map to real production harm.
RAG corpus curation may leak examples overlapping test intents, biasing the measured improvement.
Human-derived reference configs process is vague (who authors them; are they gold-standard?).
Large run count (300 intents × 3 variants) requires exact simulator-run budget and deterministic seeds to ensure reproducibility.
required_design_repairs: Precisely define 'actionable' criteria with numeric thresholds (service outage duration X, packet-loss thresholds, etc.) and justify choices.
Document RAG corpus creation, sources, and explicit steps to avoid overlap with test intents; provide hash manifest for corpora.
Define process for producing human reference configs (expert panel, adjudication) or explain acceptable automated reference.
Fix simulator configuration (tool and version), seeds, and orchestration commands; preregister subsampling or budget-based decisions if simulator time is limited.

major_concerns: Adversarial poisoning must be constructed safely—risk of producing dangerous configuration payloads if not sanitized.
Attribution of unsafe outputs to specific poisoned documents is methodologically approximate and needs validated instrumentation.
Defenses (provenance filtering) implementation details and their practical latency/utility trade-offs are underspecified.
Ethical review / safeguards and data-handling constraints for injected poison documents are not stated.
required_design_repairs: Run an explicit ethics/safety assessment and document safe-poisoning templates that avoid deployable harmful payloads.
Specify the retrieval/indexing stack and exact provenance metadata scheme; provide reproducible poisoning-generation scripts and hashes.
Define and validate attribution methodology (e.g., attention/log-provenance, retrieval scores) and its limitations.
Quantify defense overhead (latency/recall) and pre-register acceptable operational trade-offs; state exact LLM identifiers and prompts used.

major_concerns: Human-subject recruitment of 45 experienced NetOps practitioners may be infeasible under current constraints; no IRB/ethics plan provided.
If simulated reviewers are used, external validity will be limited; candidate mixes recruitment and simulation without clear decision rule.
Time-pressure operationalization (30s) is arbitrary and must be justified or varied in sensitivity analyses.
Potential automation-bias effects require careful measurement; instrumentation and questionnaires are underspecified.
required_design_repairs: Provide a concrete recruitment plan, inclusion/exclusion criteria, compensation, and IRB/ethics safeguards, or prespecify a validated simulation alternative and justify its validity.
Pre-register time-pressure levels and include sensitivity analysis; justify chosen durations with pilot data or literature.
Specify exact verifier outputs and UI shown to reviewers; record interaction logs and cognitive-load measurement instruments.
State fallback analysis plan if human recruitment is infeasible and label those results as exploratory/pilot.
